summary: drift_note()'s drifted list is truncated to drifted[:6] before the machine hook-registration/status-line line is appended (it's added last), so a session with 6 or more symlink-drift lines (CLAUDE.md, agents/*, skills/*) silently drops the settings-line warning, making a covered and an uncovered machine indistinguishable in the rendered note. Pre-existing, not introduced by the project-settings suppression fix in task d8d5dec3ef4e. Fix by ordering the settings line first, or raising/removing the cap.
